title: 240416_2723_IT_Tourists_and_church_bells_in_San_Gimignano by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Tourists and church bells in San Gimignano, Italy. I made this recording in the beautiful and amazing medieval village of San Gimignano, in Italy. One can hear lots of tourists walking and chatting in different languages, with some jackdaws and noises from restaurants in the background. At #0:34, beautiful church bells start to ring. A little windy, but still nice ! Recorded in April 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and a Rode Stereo videomic X (SVMX). Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
modifications: cut 89.92-104.92s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -12.90 dBFS); 30 ms fades
